# Kindbridge

> > Kindbridge is a telehealth platform specializing in online behavioral therapy for addiction disorders, mental health conditions, and specialized coaching for athletes and veterans.

Kindbridge provides virtual behavioral health services across the United States, offering licensed therapist-led treatment for problem gambling, sexual addiction, gaming disorders, and common mental health conditions like anxiety and depression. The platform combines individual therapy, group counseling, and specialized coaching programs tailored to specific populations including elite athletes, military personnel, and couples.

## Key Topics

- Online behavioral therapy
- Problem gambling treatment
- Sex and porn addiction therapy
- Telehealth services
- Licensed therapists
- Anxiety and depression treatment
- Addiction recovery

- Family therapy

## Addiction Treatment Services

- [Gambling Disorder Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/gambling-disorder): Specialized gambling addiction therapy from licensed therapists at Kindbridge.
- [Sports Betting Addiction Treatment](https://kindbridge.com/sports-betting-treatment): Confidential online counseling for sports betting addiction and recovery support.
- [8-Week Gambling Coaching Program](https://kindbridge.com/8-week-gambling-coaching-program): 8-week one-to-one gambling coaching program for men and women with problem gambling.
- [Sex Addiction Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/sex-addiction): Sex addiction therapy and coaching with certified counselors for compulsive sexual disorder.
- [Pornography Addiction Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/pornography-addiction): Nonjudgmental porn addiction therapy from certified therapists specializing in treatment.
- [Healthy Gaming Therapy and Coaching](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/healthy-gaming-therapy-and-coaching): Healthy gamer therapy and coaching for balanced gaming relationships.

## Mental Health Therapy Services

- [Virtual Therapy Hub](https://kindbridge.com/therapy): Kindbridge virtual therapy hub for behavioral addictions and mental health issues.
- [Anxiety Disorder Treatment](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/anxiety): Online anxiety disorder treatment and therapy with licensed counselors.
- [Depression Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/depression): Depression therapy services with expert counselors for mood improvement and engagement.
- [Stress Management Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/stress): Stress management therapy and coaching with licensed counselors for emotional wellness.
- [Anger Management Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/anger-management): Online anger management therapy for chronic anger issues with free first appointment.

## Specialized Therapy Programs

- [Couples Counseling](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/couples-counseling): Online couples counseling for relationship challenges with free assessment.
- [Family Therapy](https://kindbridge.com/therapy/family): Online family therapy for household challenges and behavioral health support.
- [Group Therapy Services](https://kindbridge.com/group-services): Online group therapy sessions for addiction and mental health throughout Southern USA.
- [Women's Problem Gambling Support Group](https://kindbridge.com/women-and-problem-gambling-support-group): Peer support group for women in problem gambling recovery with cognitive behavioral coaching.

## Specialized Populations

- [Mental Health Therapy for Athletes](https://kindbridge.com/athletes): Specialized online therapy for elite athletes addressing anxiety, addiction, and performance.
- [Sports Performance Coaching](https://kindbridge.com/athletes-peak-performance): Mental performance coaching for athletes in partnership with Momentum Labs.
- [Counseling for Veterans and Military](https://kindbridge.com/veterans-and-service-people-2): Virtual counseling for veterans and military treating PTSD, anxiety, and problem gambling.
